name: seated straddle side bend
description: From a wide seated straddle you bend sideways over one leg with the top arm reaching overhead. It stretches the inner thighs, hamstrings and the side of the trunk.
instructions: Sit with your legs spread wide and your knees pointing up.
Turn your chest to face forward and keep both sit bones on the floor.
Reach one arm overhead and bend sideways toward the opposite leg.
Rest your lower hand on the floor or on your leg.
Hold and breathe, then switch sides.
